about_the_game:
You just moved into your own apartment, and found a job at the city mall! Congratulations!

Your manager... or... managers... are a bit of an odd bunch though... every new manager you meet has some odd personality that you have to work around and make your way in this new, fast-paced, and heated story!

What to expect!

  • 15 unusual managers!

  • Multiple routes to explore!

  • Laid back story action!

  • Occasional fast-paced, heart pumping, heated "action"!

  • 12+ hours of story!

  • 300+ hand-drawn CG's! (Special scenes!)

  • Custom music/themes for each character and every moment throughout the story!

  • A gallery to look back on the memories of every CG you already found!

  • Piece together the story by exploring every single route and figure out who your employers really are!

  • Content only suitable for ages 18+

  • A great scoop of fetish content focused on large sizes and growth

  • Some horror elements

content_descriptors.notes: Mature content consists of suggestive themes, nudity, sexual acts/performances, BDSM, light non-consensual assault/sex themes, light horror themes, light sexual violence, self harm, and use of alcohol.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.10 Yosemite or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo (2.0 GHz) or newer (Apple Silicon M1/M2 fully supported via Rosetta or native build)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with OpenGL 2.0 support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz dual-core) or Apple Silicon M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better (or Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
